attention_estimate.basis: Sum of enabled sources' cadence estimates on 2026-11-17: ≈127 posts/month. Two bursty wires dominate — LangChain ≈31.5 and Socket ≈19 (a security-news burst rate) — and both carry max_items_per_day 2; the other eleven enabled sources together add ≈77/month. The briefing's selection budget bounds what actually surfaces. Five further verified blogs are listed disabled (no consumable feed) and add nothing until an HTML adapter or a smaller feed exists.

coverage: Verified pass on 2026-11-17: every main-list feed was fetched live, its item dates read, and cadences computed from those dates; blogs without feeds were read from their own indexes and are listed disabled, never silently included. Scope is deliberate: independent, still-private startups headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, weighted to AI infrastructure, developer tools and fintech. That excludes excellent blogs on geography alone (Modal and Hugging Face are New York companies — see 'unverified'), companies no longer independent (Cursor, acquired by SpaceX in August 2026), public companies, and the frontier labs, which have their own packs. Blogs whose feeds are changelog or PR wires were excluded on content, with the evidence stated per candidate. Robotics is thin by evidence, not by choice: the sector's one research-blog candidate (Physical Intelligence) could not be verified from this network, and the rest publish announcements rather than engineering writing.
